records.deidentified_narrative: pedestrian walked across the lot from pump one to the front of the store. the van began backing up as the pedestrian was walking across the lot. the pedestrian, seeing that the van was backing up, began jogging around the van instead of walking to the passenger side of the van where open spaces would allow for pedestrian traffic. as the pedestrian got to the rear driver's side of the van, she struck the van with her hand. the pedestrian advised this was done to stop the vehicle from backing into her. the pedestrian and the driver of the van spoke briefly before the van left the scene. the pedestrian advised that her hand hurt after she struck the van. the pedestrian contacted the company on the side of the van. a representative identified as gabriel luna (phone #[phone]) then contacted tpd and sent an email with pictures of the van and a statement from the technician who was driving the van at the time of the accident. the statement reads as follows: ""at about 1:50 i was leaving the gas station i did not see anyone walking and proceeded to slowly back out of the spot when i glances out my driver side mirror and saw a black woman looking down at her phone barely walk into my site from the behind the driver side of my slow-moving vehicle. i stopped and said omg she said, ""i'm so sorry"" i said oh my god, i didn't see you!"" the vehicle didn't hit her she was startled as was i but she walked into the store and then i continued to pull out. as a matter of fact, i right in front of the front door of the store so you can see she was fine. the vehicle didn't hit her or a vehicle because there was no vehicle behind me. there is no damage to my vehicle, and the dust isn't even disturbed across the entire back of the vehicle except my boot print from getting into the vehicle there isn't even a handprint on the vehicle. here are pictures of my vehicle."" officers attempted to get the identity of the driver from luna, but he never returned an email request for that information. the van is only listed as unit 1 because cris crash will not allow a pedestrian to be listed as unit 1.
